title: Evaluating Demographic Misrepresentation in Image-to-Image Portrait Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Applying image-to-image editing prompts to portraits of diverse racial groups from the FairFace dataset and using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and human annotators to measure unintended race and skin tone changes (Stereotype Replacement).

Measuring unintended gender presentation changes during generic image editing, and explicitly testing gender-occupation stereotypes by applying WinoBias-derived occupational prompts to male and female portraits to observe if the generated outputs shift toward stereotypical genders.

Evaluating unintended shifts in the apparent age of subjects when applying various editing prompts across different age groups, as well as measuring the accuracy and over-aging effects in explicit aging prompts.
